messages:
Tara: Quick heads-up — Pegasus wants a 20m POC tomorrow 09:00 PT. Target sustained 380 qps (chat 60%, embed 40%) with two 15s microbursts to 900 qps.
Evan: model pin and deployment?
Tara: pin rdx/chat-xl-v1 (8-bit) + rdx/embed-fast. Fallback to rdx/chat-medium + rdx/embed-lite. Cache prefix ON, TTL=300s. Warm-up: 8m ramp to target.
Marta: ops recs: 3 nodes (A100 equiv), autoscale min=2 max=5, batching: embed_batch=128 chat_batch=24. Disable burst queueing for this run. I'll prepare runbook and dashboard.
InfraBot: suggested bench command:
```
rdx-load --mix chat:0.6,embed:0.4 --target 380 --ramp 00:08:00 --duration 00:20:00 \n  --burst 900:00:00:15 --model-pair rdx/chat-xl-v1,rdx/embed-fast --quant 8bit --cache-ttl 300
```
Evan: buyer asked for a quick budget number to sign off infra spend. Any rough math? :thinking_face:
Tara: rough calc: assume chat avg 9 tokens/response. tokens = 380 * 1200s * 0.6 * 9 = ~2,462,400 tokens. At blended $0.00045/token =~ $1,108. Embeds = 380 * 1200 * 0.4 = 182,400 embeds @ $0.00020 =~ $36.5. Ops/support + monitoring + buffer => propose $1.6k for the POC run (itemized in quote).
Marta: dry-run metrics: chat p50=50ms p95=190ms p99=480ms; embed p50=14ms p95=50ms p99=120ms. During microbursts we saw ~3% 5xx when queue latency exceeded ~1.7s. Recommend circuit-breaker=1.5s soft-reject and queue-reject at 2s.
Evan: what about fallback behavior if dedicated pool saturates?
Marta: routing: prefer dedicated; fallback routes embeddings to hosted-embed-fast variant and chat to rdx/chat-medium with circuit-breaker 1.5s. We'll include this in the runbook and call out degraded latency for fallbacks.
Legal: NDA is on file. They request a short annex limiting raw log retention and confirmation of redaction for PII in traces. No export or compliance flags.
Tara: green to run once annex signed and allowlist applied. Action items: Marta->deploy + dashboard + runbook + allowlist; Evan->formal quote; Legal->draft annex. Post-run debrief scheduled 15m after test. :white_check_mark:
